newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ten firms eye Philippine food terminal.
newsitem.headline: Ten firms eye Philippine food terminal.

text.p: Ten foreign and local firms expressed interest to buy 51 percent of the Philippine government's Food Terminal Inc (FTI), an official of National Food Authority said on Friday.

The firms that bought bid documents were Keppel Land Ltd, Robinson's Land Corp, Filinvest Land Inc, San Miguel Corporation's property arm San Miguel Properties, Jaka Investments, Asset Management Corp, MGuirre Inc, Antipolo Properties, Ciriaco Corp and Landco.
FTI operates a 121-hectare agro-industrial complex located at the outskirt of the financial district of Makati.
A total of 44.9 million shares will be sold at a minimum of 155 pesos to a block of investors in an auction to be held on June 25.
The interested buyers are scheduled to be prequalified on May 16.
